build_FairseqNATModel: build a non-autoregressive transformer model using FairseqNATModel with a custom encoder and decoder
build_FairseqNATEncoder: build a FairseqNATEncoder with ensemble support for stacking multiple encoder outputs across models
build_FairseqNATDecoder: build a FairseqNATDecoder with optional no_encoder_attn flag and ensemble model support
enable_ensemble_FairseqNATModel: enable ensemble inference on a FairseqNATModel by passing a list of model encoders and decoders
use_ensemble_encoder_decorator: use the ensemble_encoder decorator to stack encoder outputs from multiple models into a single tensor
